results.text: Comparisons of pharmacokinetics of glimepiride in combination with Ojeok-san versus glimepiride alone: an open-label, one-sequence, two-treatment controlled clinical study. Glimepiride remains a cost-effective antidiabetic treatment despite its potential risks. However, its interaction with traditional medicines like Ojeok-san (OJS), a commonly used herbal medication, warrants investigation.
